headline: Bitcoin slid to a four-month low near $61,300 as the tech sell-off spread to Asia, savers in Sky's stUSDS pool still cannot withdraw, and Anthropic shares fell after hours.

ETH and SOL from CoinGecko; CoinGecko did not show ETH's 24h direction clearly, and CoinMarketCap showed SOL higher (about $75.09, +1.22%). Use the live prices on this page.

stories.title: Bitcoin hits a four-month low near $61,300 as the sell-off spreads to Asia
stories.summary: Bitcoin fell to its lowest price since early July late on Thursday as US tech stocks slid, and more than $600 million of leveraged bets were forced shut. On Friday morning Tokyo stocks dropped almost 4%. Money is also still leaving US bitcoin funds: close to $3 billion so far this month.
points: Bitcoin fell to nearly $61,300 late Thursday, its lowest since early July, with about $660 million of liquidations, per CoinDesk.
Japan's Nikkei 225 was down 3.95% at 56,694.34 early Friday, and the US 10-year Treasury yield was 5.052%, per Journal Arta.

US spot bitcoin funds lost a net $306.5 million on Wednesday 18 Nov, and $2.89 billion in November through 18 Nov, per Farside data reported by crypto.news. Thursday's figure was not available when this was written.

stories.title: Sky's stUSDS savers still cannot withdraw, and nearly half the pool's loans sit in vaults linked to a founder address
stories.summary: Sky's high-yield stUSDS savings pool is fully lent out, so depositors cannot take money out right now. New on-chain reporting says nearly half of what has been borrowed sits in vaults linked to a rune.eth wallet; analysts link it to founder Rune Christensen. Its USDS stablecoin still trades at $1 after its supply shrank by more than 30%. The lesson: a big yield can come with your money being locked when everyone wants out at once.
points: The pool holds about 161 million USDS, all of it lent out, per The Defiant.
Vaults tied to a rune.eth Safe owe 77.1 million USDS, about 48% of the borrowing, per The Defiant.
The pool's rate has been stepped up to 24.74%, per The Defiant.

USDS supply fell by more than 30% to $3.2 billion as more than $1.5 billion of USDC left Sky's swap reserve; Christensen says USDS is over-collateralised with about $10 billion in backing, per CoinDesk.
The run started after a report that $518 million of illicit-linked activity, $101.9 million of it tied to North Korea, passed through Sky's swap system, per CoinDesk.

sources.label: The Defiant (via Cryptonews): stUSDS fully borrowed
CoinDesk: USDS shrinks after illicit-finance report
CoinDesk: North Korean hackers used Sky's system

stories.title: Anthropic falls after hours, and Binance refunds $500M from its tokenized IPO offer
stories.summary: Anthropic (ticker ANT) closed its first day at $97.17, then fell in after-hours trading. Separately, Binance Wallet's offer to get crypto users into the IPO through tokenized shares secured only a tiny number of shares, so it is giving back all the USDC people put in. Tokenized IPO products are not the same as owning the stock, and they can fail to deliver.
points: ANT opened at $111.50 and closed at $97.17; after hours it was down 6.3% at $91.05 as of 20:57 ET, per Investing.com.
Part of the after-hours drop followed a Bloomberg report that Apple is hiring for an AI agent project, per Kotak Neo.
Binance Wallet is refunding 500,002,764 USDC of subscriptions after receiving only about 2,957 tokenized shares, and blamed "force majeure factors", per Phemex's relay of PANews.
Binance is also handing out $1 million of compensation tokens, per PANews.

sources.label: Kotak Neo: shares fall after hours

briefs.title: Binance.US derivatives application moves to full CFTC review
briefs.summary: The CFTC deemed Binance.US's application "materially complete", which starts the review; it is not an approval, and no perpetual futures launch until both registrations are granted, per Cryptonews.

briefs.title: Binance-hack wallet moves $248M of ETH
briefs.summary: A wallet flagged by the FBI moved about 137,602 ETH on 19 Nov in wallet-to-wallet transfers, per Lookonchain data reported by The Defiant.

briefs.title: Ledger's CTO to leave at the end of 2026
briefs.summary: Charles Guillemet says the change was planned for months and did not link it to the probe into tampered Ledger devices, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: $3.4M drained from a DeFi vault in minutes
briefs.summary: Attackers manipulated how K3 Capital's sBOLD vault priced its shares; Ethereum block builders ended up with most of the money, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: MARA sold about $1.1B of bitcoin
briefs.summary: The miner used $750 million to repay bitcoin-backed loans, per Analytics Insight.

briefs.title: Kalshi board member on insider trading in prediction markets
briefs.summary: Kalshi board member and former CFTC commissioner Quintenz said insider trading is "just easier to see" on prediction markets than in stocks, per The Block.
